title: Gimbal pilot confirms the LNS radar target

tellings.quote: explain the LNS is the launch and steering which is the selected radar target

plain: In the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy cockpit recording made off the US East Coast of an object that seems to turn, the pilots can be heard talking. Marik von Rennenkampf, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, explains that when they mention the LNS they mean the launch and steering target, the one the radar has locked on to, which he says shows the object was a real radar target and not only a picture on the camera.
